create_qdrant_multitenant_collection: create a multi-tenant Qdrant collection with tenant isolation, payload indexes for tenant_id and metadata fields
upsert_vector_items: upsert vector items into a multi-tenant Qdrant collection with automatic tenant ID assignment and collection creation
search_nearest_neighbors: search nearest neighbor vectors in a multi-tenant Qdrant collection with tenant-isolated filtering
delete_vectors_by_id: delete vectors from a multi-tenant Qdrant collection by ID or filter with tenant isolation
reset_qdrant_collections: reset the Qdrant database by deleting all collections matching the configured collection prefix
